content.comment_body: Hello. I recall another user experiencing an issue where the [product_name] mobile communication module stopped receiving SMS messages once the card's available slots were filled by module and time data. No warning was provided before the reception stopped. Thank you for sharing this information. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes a situation where the [product_name] mobile communication module ceases to receive SMS messages silently when its storage slots are filled by module and time data. This points to a lack of alerts and indicates possible shortcomings in data management within the system.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates improved handling of card storage in the [product_name] module, such as overwriting older data, giving warnings before SMS reception ends, or managing memory to ensure incoming messages are not lost.
